meta.description: Ispahani Ideal School in Brahmanbaria provides quality education, experienced teachers, and modern facilities to help students succeed academically and personally.

hero.title: Where Knowledge Meets Character
hero.subtitle: Welcome to the official website of Brahmanbaria Ispahani Ideal School. We combine academic rigor, moral integrity, and modern facilities to prepare the youth of Brahmanbaria to lead tomorrow.

aboutPreview.title: A Tradition of Academic Rigor & Moral Integrity
aboutPreview.description: At Brahmanbaria Ispahani Ideal School, we believe education goes beyond textbooks. Our holistic approach integrates rigorous academic drills with leadership training, cultural appreciation, and moral grounding.
aboutPreview.pillar1Desc: Awakening an unquenchable wonder for scientific inquiry, literature, and mathematics.
aboutPreview.pillar2Desc: Nurturing moral courage, empathy, discipline, and profound respect for our shared heritage.
aboutPreview.pillar3Desc: Culminating in distinguished academic mastery and the confidence to shape the future.
aboutPreview.imageAlt: Students and Architecture at Brahmanbaria Ispahani Ideal School

advantages.title: Why Parents Choose Our School
advantages.subtitle: We provide an enriching educational environment designed to nurture confident, capable, and compassionate young minds.
advantages.card1Text: Consistent board examination successes through structured curricula and dedicated tutoring.
advantages.card2Text: Instilling strong moral ethics, discipline, empathy, and respect for community heritage.
advantages.card3Text: Equipped with advanced science labs, digital classrooms, secure campus, and rich libraries.
advantages.card4Text: Active encouragement in athletics, debating, robotics, and arts alongside academic studies.
advantages.card5Text: Our dedicated educators bring years of classroom expertise, pedagogical innovation, and mentorship to guide every student toward success.
advantages.card6Text: Our campuses provide a secure, monitored, and welcoming environment where students can learn, collaborate, and thrive with peace of mind.

galleryPreview.title: Living Campus Mosaic
galleryPreview.subtitle: An authentic window into daily discovery, cultural vibrancy, and academic companionship.

cta.title: Give Your Child the Foundation They Deserve
cta.subtitle: Admissions are currently open for the upcoming academic session across both Main and Bijeswar campuses.
